As part of the festival’s 2021 edition, Sir John Eliot Gardiner leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program that includes Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17, ‘Little Russian’, and Edward Elgar’s Variations on an Original Theme, Op. 36, better known as the Enigma Variations. Written in 1872, Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 2 bears the nickname ‘Little Russian’, as the composer used folk tunes in his work from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia’. Completed in 1899, Elgar’s Enigma Variations is an orchestral work comprising a theme and fourteen variations, each variation being a musical sketch of one of the composer’s friends. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839. Bearing a dedication to Franz Liszt, it is one of Schumann's greatest works for solo piano, and a central work of the early Romantic period. Written in a loose sonata form, the first movement is rhapsodic and passionate, the middle movement is a grandiose rondo, and the finale is slow and meditative. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: B. Marini - La Romanesca
programme.desc: Argentinian conductor and harpsichordist Leonardo García Alarcón leads his ensemble Cappella Mediterranea in a program of Italian Baroque music. The ensemble performs some of the finest Baroque pieces composed by Francesco Cavalli, a prominent composer in 17th-century Venice, and two of his famous students, Barbara Strozzi and Antonia Bembo. Argentinian soprano Mariana Flores presents the vocal works. On the program are ‘Mira questi due lumi’ from Cavalli’s Le nozze di Teti e di Peleo, ‘Dimmi, Amor, che farò’ from L'Oristeo, ‘Sinfonia della notte’ from L’Egisto, and ‘E vuol dunque Ciprigna’ from Ercole Amante; ‘M’ingannasti in verità’ from Bembo’s Produzioni armoniche consacrate a Luigi XIV; Strozzi’s Sino alla morte, Che si può fare, Lagrime mie, L’amante segreto, and è Pazzo il moi core; Biagio Marini’s La Romanesca; Tarquinio Merula’s Aria Sopra La Cieccona; and Dario Castello’s Sonata Seconda. This performance was recorded at the magnificent Église Notre-Dame of Sablé-sur-Sarthe, France, on August 26, 2020.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Sonata No 16, K. 545: II. Andante
programme.desc: On August 19, 2000, the Teatro Colón was filled to the brim with spectators longing to hear Daniel Barenboim play the piano. Barenboim, who is currently best known as a conductor, started his career half a century ago as a child prodigy, playing his first piano recital at age 7. This concert celebrates the maestro's on-stage career. Only after the maestro had performed for a full three hours, including no less than 13 encores, the audience was willing to let him leave the stage: a special evening if ever there was one! The concert included Ludwig van Beethoven's Sonata No. 23 ‘Apassionata’, Frederic Chopin's Waltz in e minor, and Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Sonata in C major.

programme.title: Beethoven - 7 Variations: 'Bei Männer..', WoO 46
programme.desc: In Geneva, the Swiss city where she has spent most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play chamber music. Between the pieces, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit in an intimate interview that addresses both their relationship and the music. On the program are Ludwig van Beethoven’s 7 variations after "The Magic Flute"; Robert Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 73; Frédéric Chopin’s Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3; ‘Lerchengesang’ (No. 2) from Johannes Brahms’s 4 Gesänge, Op. 70; and ‘Largo’ from Chopin’s Cello Sonata in G minor, Op. 65. This broadcast was recorded on November 12 and 13, 2020, in Geneva, Switzerland.

programme.title: Schumann - Carnaval, Op. 9
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann wrote Carnaval, Op. 9 in 1834–1835. It consists of 21 short pieces representing masked revelers at Carnival, a festival before Lent. Schumann gives musical expression to himself, his friends and colleagues, and characters from improvised Italian comedy (commedia dell'arte). Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures! It will be fun, touching, crazy and dramatic when the Concert Hall is filled with living lines drawn in tones in the big room. The DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Big Band and DR Vocal Ensemble have joined forces to take you to a party in the cartoon universes.

programme.title: Mendelssohn - Trio No. 1 Op. 49
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich, violinist Tedi Papavrami and cellist Mischa Maisky perform Felix Mendelssohn’s Piano Trio No. 1 in D minor, Op. 49.

programme.title: Music in the air
programme.desc: Television plays a crucial role in popularizing classical music. Not only has it preserved precious moments of music making, but it also helps shape the future of music. The Vienna-based IMZ International Music + Media Centre, a global association for all those involved in any aspect of classical and contemporary music, world music, jazz, and dance, celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2015. To commemorate this, renowned film maker Reiner E. Moritz produced the documentary 'Music in the air' to shed light on the history of classical music on television. The film dives into television's archives to demonstrate what the medium has done for the dissemination of music. It features rare footage of Arturo Toscanini conducting the NBC Symphony Orchestra in one of the first televised concerts, and captivating fragments from Leonard Bernstein’s Young People Concerts. Moreover, the film contains excerpts of great performances from the past, including those by Glenn Gould, Herbert von Karajan, Igor Stravinsky, and Pierre Boulez.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13. Composed between 1834-37, the work began as a theme and a set of sixteen variations. The theme had been composed by Baron von Fricken, an amateur musician and father of Ernestine von Fricken, to whom Schumann was engaged in 1834. The work was first published in 1837, containing the theme and twelve etudes (only nine of them were indicated ‘variations’). Fifteen years later, in 1852, Schumann published a second edition of the work, eliminating two etudes and making some revisions to the piano writing. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828. Basing itself on her letters and diaries, her compositions, and on accounts from musicians who have intensively studied her music, this 2019 documentary offers a multi-angled perspective on Clara Schumann. It records the various places where she lived, and the cities she visited as a pianist. This thought-provoking film was directed by Andreas Morell and Magdalena Zieba-Schwind.

programme.title: Beethoven - Quintet for piano and winds, Op. 16
programme.desc: Luca Vignali (oboe), Angelo De Angelis (clarinet), Carmine Pinto (horn), Eliseo Smordoni (bassoon), and Linda Di Carlo (piano) perform Ludwig van Beethoven’s Quintet for piano and winds in E-flat major, Op. 16. The piece, completed in 1796, is assumed to have been modelled on Mozart’s Quintet for piano and winds, K. 452. Both quintets are scored for the same unusual instrument combination, are in the same key, and feature the same three-movement structure. A marked difference is that Beethoven, as a piano virtuoso, wrote the piano parts to highlight the strengths of his playing. Besides, the composer regularly places this instrument in the center of attention. Beethoven published the work in 1801 in two versions: as a quintet for piano and winds, and as a quartet for piano and strings (also designated Op. 16). This performance was recorded at Perugia’s Auditorium Santa Cecilia, Italy, on June 23, 2022.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. Beethoven wrote the work upon completion of his Symphony No. 5. Both symphonies premiered at the same legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 6 consists of five movements, of which the last three are played without a break. Each movement carries a title that suggests a scene from life in the countryside. The joyful atmosphere of the first three movements is interrupted by the violent fourth movement ‘Thunder, Storm’, as expressed by the piccolos, brass, and timpani. As the storm recedes at the end of the movement, the tranquility returns in the final movement. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Chamber music by Janáček, Taffanel and Prokofiev
programme.desc: This chamber music concert is part of the ‘Solistas del Siglo XXI’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid. First, Quinteto Zéphyros performs Leoš Janáček’s Mládí (‘Youth’) for wind sextet. This is followed by French flautist Paul Taffanel’s Wind Quintet in G minor, performed by Quinteto Scarlatti de Casa de la Moneda. The program closes with Sergei Prokofiev’s Quintet in G minor, Op. 39, played by Quinteto Cosan. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on May 11, 2024.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, Op. 73
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker, Daniel Barenboim and Claudio Abbado star at the Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen, Germany, performing Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 and Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 2. Popularly known as the Emperor Concerto and composed in Vienna between 1809 and 1811, Piano Concerto No. 5 is Beethoven’s last completed piano concerto and often performed by star pianists such as Daniel Barenboim. A few decades later in 1877, Brahms completed his Second Symphony, which is often compared to Beethoven’s Sixth Symphony given its cheerful and pastoral character.

programme.title: Triple Concerto, Op. 56 & Symphonie Fantastique
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the combined forces of the Music Academy KestonMAX fellows and London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Ludwig van Beethoven’s Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, and Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14. Beethoven's Concerto for Violin, Cello, and Piano in C major, commonly known as the Triple Concerto, was composed from 1803 to 1804. The choice of the three solo instruments effectively makes this a concerto for piano trio, and it is the only concerto Beethoven ever completed for more than one solo instrument. Berlioz's Symphonie Fantastique (‘Episode in the Life of an Artist … in Five Sections’) is a programmatic symphony written in 1830, telling the story of a gifted artist who, in the depths of hopelessness and despair because of his unrequited love for a woman, has poisoned himself with opium. This concert was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s in London, UK, on November 20, 2022.

programme.title: Ravel - Ma mère l'Oye
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023. As part of this concert, pianists Martha Argerich and Khramouchin’s widow Eliane Reyes perform Maurice Ravel’s Ma mère l'Oye. This five-part suite was written for piano four hands.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Sleeping Beauty (2013)
programme.desc: The award-winning Imperial Ice Stars are 26 Olympic, World, European and National Championship skaters, who jointly hold over 250 competition medals, performing theatrical ice dancing on a frozen theatre stage. The Imperial Ice Stars have received five-star praise from critics and standing ovations from audiences at some of the world's most prestigious venues - London’s Royal Albert Hall and Sadler's Wells, Singapore's Esplanade Theatre, Montreal's Place des Arts and Cape Town's Artscape. This stunning performance, filmed at the Melbourne Theatre Company in Australia, offers a new look on the secular tale of Sleeping beauty, with the original music of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky (1840-1893).

programme.title: Works by Gluck, Bach and Mozart
programme.desc: Venezuelan-born conductor Giovanni Guzzo leads the Camerata Fundación EDP of the Reina Sofía School of Music in a spirited concert. The program opens with the ethereal ‘Danza degli spiriti beati’ (Dance of the Blessed Spirits) from Christoph Willibald Gluck’s opera Orfeo ed Euridice, featuring flutist Matthew Raymond Origel. The concert continues with vocal masterworks, including J.S. Bach’s brilliant cantata aria ‘Jauchzet Gott in allen Landen!’, BWV 51, featuring soprano Marlin González Zúñiga and trumpeter Marc Ferrando Pelegrí, and W.A. Mozart’s joyous motet Exsultate, jubilate, K. 165, sung by soprano Carla Isabel Gómez del Pulgar. The concert concludes with one of the great classical works: Mozart’s dramatic Symphony No. 40 in G minor. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on December 18, 2024.

programme.title: Mahler - The Song of Lamentation
programme.desc: Mexican conductor José Areán leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería and four vocal soloists in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s cantata ‘The Song of Lamentation’ (Das klagende Lied). Among the soloists are soprano Sally Dibblee, mezzo-soprano Marjorie Elinor Dix, tenor Arturo Chacón, and bass Stephen West. Written between 1878-1880, the work is based on a fairy tale by Ludwig Bechstein and the brothers Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm about two brothers, one good and one cruel, who become rivals for a queen’s hand. The story culminates in the murder of the virtuous younger brother and the subsequent discovery of his bones, from which a minstrel makes a flute that sings of the crime. This chilling tale is brought to life in the cantata through music and a minstrel’s flute, which exposes the truth at the royal court. This performance was recorded at Sala Nezahualcóyotl of the Centro Cultural Universitario in Mexico City, in 2012.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 1. Op. 1
programme.desc: Piano soloist Boris Berezovsky is accompanied by the Moscow Philharmonic Orchestra under the baton of Alexander Sladkovsky in a performance of Sergei Rachmaninov's Piano Concerto no. 1, Op. 1. Rachmaninov composed his first concerto while studying at the Moscow Conservatory at the age of 18. The concert opens with 'Heavenly Movement', a composition by the young Russian composer Elmir Nizamov (*1986). This concert was recorded at the Tchaikovksy Concert Hall of the Moscow Philharmonic Society on April 28, 2017.

programme.title: Copland - Appalachian Spring
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Aaron Copland’s Appalachian Spring Suite. Originally commissioned as a ballet for the legendary dancer Martha Graham, Aaron Copland's Appalachian Spring (1944) has since become an American classic. While first scored for a thirteen-piece ensemble, Copland later arranged the work for a full orchestra. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Nacional in Mexico City, in 2021.

programme.title: Rachmaninov - Études Op. 33, No.4
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight’, followed by Alexander Glazunov’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in E minor, Op. 75. Then Lugansky performs a selection of works by Rachmaninoff: Rachmaninoff’s piano transcription of J. S. Bach’s Partita No. 3 in E major; a selection of Études-Tableaux (Nos. 1, 2, 4, and 8, Op, 33, and Nos. 5 and 6, Op. 39); Lilac (Op. 21, No. 5); Prelude in C minor, Op. 23 No. 7; and Rachmaninoff’s transcription of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Lullaby (Op. 16 No. 1). This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.

programme.title: Bernstein - Tonight (West Side Story)
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff. On the program are Busoni’s Kultaselle – 10 variations on a Finnish folksong; Liszt’s Two Elegies for cello and piano; Chopin’s Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3; and Rachmaninoff’s Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19. As an encore, the duo plays Leonard Bernstein’s iconic composition ‘Tonight’ from the musical West Side Story. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel & Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. Completed in 1802, the work saw its first performance at the Theater an der Wien on April 5, 1803. That same concert also included the premieres of the composer’s Piano Concerto No. 3 and his only oratorio, Christ on the Mount of Olives, as well as a reprise performance of his Symphony No. 1. Instead of the traditional minuet, Beethoven wrote a lively scherzo as the third movement of his Symphony No 2. The overall mood of the work is optimistic. Jordan’s performance was recorded at Palais Garnier in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Dvořák - Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Antonín Dvořák's Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70. The work was completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvořák’s broader oeuvre. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, on January 29, 2021.

programme.title: Barber - Adagio for Strings
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Samuel Barber’s Adagio for Strings. Completed in 1936, Barber arranged the piece for string orchestra from the second movement of his String Quartet, Op. 11. Adagio for Strings is one of the most recognizable pieces of classical music. The work’s emotional weight has led to its frequent use in film, often to evoke scenes of sorrow or tragedy. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Nacional in Mexico City, in 2021.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Antonio Chen Guang
programme.desc: Pianist Antonio Chen Guang (China, 1994) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai – Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). It was recorded at Bourgie Hall in the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.

programme.title: Beethoven - Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20
programme.desc: The soloists from the Lucerne Festival Orchestra present Ludwig van Beethoven’s Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20, which is scored for clarinet, horn, bassoon, violin, viola, cello and double bass. This 1799 piece achieved great popularity during Beethoven’s lifetime. It was arranged for many various instrumental ensembles, including versions for two guitars, and piano four-hands, but also a trio for clarinet (or violin), cello, and piano, arranged by Beethoven himself. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in 2020.

programme.title: Nino Rota - La notte di un nevrastenico
programme.desc: The 2017 Reate Festival in Rieti, Italy staged two short operas composed by Nino Rota. Known chiefly for his cinema soundtracks and his lifelong relationship with iconic directors such as Federico Fellini, Francis Ford Coppola and Luchino Visconti (to name but a few), Rota was a musical enfant prodige who composed sacred music as well as operas from a very young age. Endowed with a streak of freedom, creativity and imagination that allowed him to forge his own unique style, he succeeded in merging the great Italian operatic tradition of Rossini, Puccini and Verdi with a contemporary musical language, setting himself apart from his contemporaries in the process. La notte di un nevrastenico premiered at the Piccola Scala in 1960; the libretto is by Riccardo Bacchelli. It’s a short farce with a tragic, unexpected ending. This version was performed by the Reate Festival Orchestra under the baton of Gabriele Bonolis.

programme.title: Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway. Glass’s work, originally a choral piece for the Australian Dance Theatre, was only ever performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Over thirty years later, in 2019, Beacon Isle Films recorded a symphonic arrangement of Glass’s work, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss with soprano Berit Norbakken Solset as the soloist. Their recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten’s spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe’s story. Moreover, this inspiring documentary features a rare interview with Glass.

programme.title: Delibes - Lakmé
programme.desc: Frédéric Chaslin (1963) leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Opéra Royal de Wallonie-Liège in a performance of Léo Delibes’s tragic opera Lakmé (1883). Written to a libretto by Edmond Gondinet and Philippe Gille, the opera is set in nineteenth-century British India and tells the story of Lakmé, who falls in love with Gérald, a British officer. However, Lakmé’s father, the Brahmin priest Nilakantha, vows revenge after he discovers that Gérald has trespassed on their sacred ground. Like many of his contemporaries, Delibes was fond of exoticism, evoking foreign lands and cultures in the tradition of Georges Bizet’s Les Pêcheurs de perles (1863) and Camille Saint-Saëns’s Samson et Dalila (1877). Delibes’s opera features the celebrated “Flower Duet,” sung by Lakmé and her servant Mallika as they gather flowers by the river, and also the wonderful coloratura aria “Bell Song” (Air des Clochettes). Among the soloists are Jodie Devos, Philippe Talbot, Lionel Lhote, Pierre Doyen, and Marion Lebègue. This production was recorded at the Opéra Royal de Wallonie in Liège, Belgium, in 2022.

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16. French pianist Pascal Amoyel features as the soloist. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. It is the composer’s only concerto. The work premiered on April 3, 1869 in Copenhagen, Denmark, with Edmund Neupert as the soloist, and was received enthusiastically. The Norwegian premiere followed a few months later. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016.

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr. - Concertgebouw Amsterdam
programme.desc: In 1967, American singer and actor Sammy Davis Jr. appeared at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam for a live, nationwide TV broadcast. Supported by his band, Davis combined his singing talent and sense of humor as he covered songs from a variety of genres.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals.

programme.title: Live in London 2013
programme.desc: The Apple Music Festival (formerly known as the iTunes Festival) was a music concert series held by Apple, Inc. inaugurated in 2007.

programme.title: Recorda Me
programme.desc: In 1982, the Superstar Quintet, which consists of trumpeter Freddie Hubbard, saxophonist Joe Henderson, drummer Tony Williams, bassist Ron Carter, and pianist Kenny Baron gave a performance of cosmic proportions at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan - Maria
programme.desc: Arguably the greatest lady vocalists of all time are featured in this superb compilation. These historic recordings from the 1950s and 1960s offer a unique overview of different approaches to jazz singing that helped define the genre.

programme.title: H. Silver, M. Waters, D. Gillespie - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: In 1968, the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam welcomed three talented Americans: pianist Horace Silver, guitarist Muddy Waters, and trumpeter Dizzy Gillespie, alongside their bands.

programme.title: The New Conrad Miller Trio Live at Mocher's
programme.desc: Pianist Coen Molenaar – aka Conrad Miller – is active on the international jazz, fusion, dance, funk, R&B, rock, and neo-soul scenes. In this 2021 recording, Miller plays contemporary trio jazz with David de Marez Oyens (bass) and Enrique Firpi (drums).

programme.title: Tyner, Hubbard & Henderson - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: In 1986, American pianist McCoy Tyner brought an all-star cast to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. With trumpeter Freddie Hubbard, saxophonist Joe Henderson, bassist Avery Sharpe, and drummer Louis Hayes, they put on a magical performance.

programme.title: Bobby McFerrin - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: In 1985, American vocal virtuoso Bobby McFerrin took the stage solo at Estival Jazz Lugano. The one-man musical force stunned the audience with his unique vocal percussion as he delved into the crowd for this quirky and charming act.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk - Around about midnight
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists.

programme.title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: The foremost jazz composer and bandleader of the twentieth century, Duke Ellington, returns with his orchestra to the festival where he revived his career in 1956, albeit in Brussels in 1973 with one of his final bands, less than a year before his death.

programme.title: Austin City Limits
programme.desc: Mixing classic R&B vocals with a soulful blues-rock base, Alabama Shakes have taken garage rock and turned it on its head. Alabama Shakes takes the Austin City Limits stage for the second time in support of their newest album Sound & Color.

programme.title: Rhoda Scott & La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: Although American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, this performance at the antique theatre of Vienne is special: she presents an intimate and beautiful performance with US gospel and blues singer La Velle.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Boogieball with Anthony Hamilton
programme.desc: This episode of BIRD is a fantastic registration of the after party of the North Sea Jazz Festival. This mega jam session is a great coming together of, amongst others, Anthony Hamilton, Anderson Paak, Christian Scott, Cory Henry and Kneebody!

programme.title: Horace Silver
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz.

programme.title: The Kenny Garrett Quintet
programme.desc: Kenny Garrett emerged in the early 1980s, redefining the alto sax with powerful intensity. His album Sounds from the Ancestors blends jazz, R&B and gospel roots from Detroit with a modern global sound.

programme.title: Grégory Privat - SOLEY
programme.desc: Pianist Grégory Privat's 2020 work "Soley" inhabits a hybrid universe in which voice, piano and synthesizer, Caribbean and electronic music, and the classical and jazz trio traditions coexist and mingle.

programme.title: Respect to Aretha
programme.desc: To close its 2019 edition, Jazz à la Villette pays tribute to the queen of soul Aretha Franklin, who died in the summer of 2018.

programme.title: Medley
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne with music inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa’: a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock. Although his new sound has its roots in Brazilian culture, it is always inspired by jazz.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: The vibrant island of Malta was in for a night of light and cheerful music when Brazilian music legend João Bosco took the stage on July 21, 2018.

programme.title: Betty Carter/Jazzmeia Horn, Please Do Something
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Horn’s concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2022
programme.desc: Among the bands presenting themselves at jazzahead! 2024 is Sultan Stevenson’s trio. Pianist Stevenson, a Londoner with Caribbean roots, graduated from Conservatory in 2023. He is a rapidly rising talent in the London jazz circuit, whose debut album 'Faithful One' won him the Parliamentary Jazz Award for the best newcomer. Described by The Telegraph as “an incipient master”, Sultan Stevenson (piano) appears at jazzahead! 2024 with Jacob Gryn (bass) and Joel Waters (drums).

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Bebop
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity.

programme.title: Portrait of Roy Ayers
programme.desc: ‘The legend of the groove’ is a series of documentaries about musicians who, between the late 1950s and now, have radically influenced the music of today's hip hop, soul, and rhythm 'n' blues greats, like Prince, Erykah Badu, Janis Joplin and Jimi Hendrix.

programme.title: Ray Charles and the Raelettes - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: In 1980, American soul legend Ray Charles brought the Raelettes and the Ray Charles Orchestra to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. With them behind him, Charles showed why he has been viewed as one of the most recognizable voices in music.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks & Company - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: In 1982, vocalese maestro Jon Hendricks brought his wife Judith Hendricks, daughter Michelle Hendricks, mouth trumpeter Bob Gurland, pianist Michael Weiss, bassist Murray Wall and drummer Marvin Smith to perform at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Jim Hall & Atilla Zoller - Extensions
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence.

programme.title: Karin Fernandes - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Karin Fernandes is dedicated to the performance of 20th and 21st century piano repertoire and has performed with prestigious Brazilian orchestras.

programme.title: Episode 6: Herbie Hancock - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American keyboard player and bandleader Herbie Hancock gained wide popularity as a leader of electric jazz-rock groups. Hancock’s band The Headhunters appeared on German television in 1974, performing songs like Palm Grease, Spank-A-Lee, and Chameleon.

programme.title: Michelle David - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul at Jazz in Duketown 2019.

programme.title: Omer Avital Qantar - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Israeli-American double bassist Omer Avital plays radiantly energetic, resounding jazz with oriental influences. At Jazz in Duketown 2019, Avital presents singular repertoire based on his album 'Qantar'.

programme.title: The last chieftain
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Shayna Steele
programme.desc: In today’s episode of BIRD, Shayna Steele presents swinging acoustic Samba to storming guitar funk, everything fits like a mould. Presented with a generous portion of charm and impressive dynamic.

programme.title: La nuit des gitans

programme.title: North Sea Jazz

programme.title: Gregory Porter and Metronomy - Paris
programme.desc: This program follows American baritone Gregory Porter as he collaborates with the British electro-pop band Metronomy. Porter gives an interview at Château Hérouville and performs songs including ‘Don't Loose Your Steam’, ‘In Fashion’, and ‘Sunny’.

programme.title: On Piano
programme.desc: This documentary traces the first two decades of jazz in Latvia in this portrait of Jack Michalicky, the first known Latvian jazz pianist. This brief yet insightful documentary was produced by Latvian Mareks Ameriks.

programme.title: Brazilian NYE
programme.desc: Da Pá Virada Sessions and Stingray present Brazilian singer-songwriter Paulo Novaes in an intimate performance, which was recorded in Novaes' native city of São Paulo.

programme.title: Maceo Parker: Jazz a Juan
programme.desc: At 25, saxophonist Maceo Parker played in James Brown's band, but today he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band.

programme.title: Christian McBride - John Day
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Michael Brecker Band - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: In 1989, American saxophonist Michael Brecker played at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Joined by bassist Jeff Andrews, drummer Adam Nussbaum, pianist Joey Calderazzo, and guitarist Mike Stern, Brecker displayed his virtuosity in spades.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Bassekou Kouyaté
programme.desc: This episode of BIRD is a fantastic registration of Bassekou Kouyaté, one of the true masters of the ngoni, an ancient traditional lute found throughout West Africa, and he has collaborated with many musicians in and outside of Mali.

programme.title: On a Slow Boat to China
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all time, Stan Getz emerged was one of the most significant musical forces of post-World War II jazz. This program shows his last public performance, at Munich Philharmonic Hall, Germany on July 18, 1990.

programme.title: Ode to Miles: Bitches Brew Beyond
programme.desc: Trumpeter Wallace Roney revives Miles Davis' legendary album, Bitches Brew. In this project - a brainchild of Miles' family - Miles' nephew takes part: drummer Vince Wilburn. This concert at Vienne's ancient theater in France is a grand tribute to Miles.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson with NHØP - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: In 1979, legendary Canadian pianist Oscar Peterson gave a stunning performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. With talented double bassist Niels-Henning Ørsted Pedersen accompanying him, Peterson demonstrated his piano skills with aplomb.

programme.title: Bill Evans' European Tour: Live in '64, '65 & '70
programme.desc: Bill Evans: Live in '64, '65 & '70 features five separate performances by one of the most revered pianists in music history.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2022
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Among the performing bands is Larnell Lewis’s septet.

programme.title: MPB Sessions - Pedro Viáfora & Celso Viáfora
programme.desc: Pedro Viáfora and Celso Viáfora are a father-and-son duo that brings together different generations of Brazilian music. Together, they reinterpret the tradition of MPB (Brazilian Popular Music) with sharp social commentary.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2022
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Among the artists presenting themselves at jazzahead! 2023 is Brazilian virtuoso pianist Amaro Freitas.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2022 - Francois Bourassa Quartet
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Among the performing bands is the François Bourassa Quartet.

programme.title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: Larry Graham & Graham Central Station perform at Bataclan in Paris, where numerous ‘funkateers’ cheer the famed bass player. Funk hero Graham, one-time pioneer of the art of slap-pop playing on the electric bass, shows what he's made of!

programme.title: Lionel Hampton Big Band - Kurhaus Scheveningen
programme.desc: In 1983, American vibraphonist Lionel Hampton performed at the Kurhaus in Scheveningen. Accompanied by his big band, which included talents such as saxophonist Arnett Cobb, the "King of the Vibes" gave an energizing performance with both mallets and voice.

programme.title: Footprints
programme.desc: In 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist. She brought African music to a Western audience, and popularized the world music and Afropop genres.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument.

programme.title: Erroll Garner: Belgium 1963
programme.desc: Erroll Garner was one of jazz’s true original players and this showcases his improvisational brilliance on a parade of his most classic numbers, such as “Fly Me To The Moon” and “I Get A Kick Out Of You”.

programme.title: Ricardo Herz Trio - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Ricardo Herz Trio consists of Ricardo Herz on violin, Michi Ruzitschka on nylon string guitar, and Pedro Ito on percussion. Band leader Ricardo Herz is a classically-trained musician, who also studied jazz at the prestigious Berklee College of Music.

programme.title: Tania Maria Trio - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: In 1988, acclaimed Brazilian singer and pianist Tania Maria performed with bassist Leonard Traversa and drummer Kim Plainfield at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Maria is known for her energetic personality and unique style of singing.

programme.title: Songs She Never Heard
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah.

programme.title: Forró Series
programme.desc: Influenced by the music of the past and present, samba collective Samba pros Orixás bridges the gap between tradition and modernity.

programme.title: Billie Holiday
programme.desc: This compilation features recordings from the 1950s of Billie Holiday singing a string of her greatest successes. Enjoy this unique footage of one of jazz’s all-time greats!

programme.title: Melody Gardot at Château d'Hérouville
programme.desc: This program follows American singer-songwriter Melody Gardot as she visits the legendary studio Château d'Hérouville in France. After an accident in 2003 left her hypersensitive to light and sound, Gardot discovered the healing power of music.

programme.title: O.P. Trio and E. Fitz. - Jazz At The Philharmonic
programme.desc: On May 5, 1957, jazz impresario Norman Granz presented Canadian pianist Oscar Peterson's trio, American violinist Stuff Smith, and American singer Ella Fitzgerald during the Jazz at the Philharmonic concert at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.desc: McCoy Tyner is considered one of the most influential jazz pianists of the 20th century, an honour he earned both with Coltrane and in his years of performing following Coltrane’s death.

programme.title: Horace Silver - Song for my father

programme.title: Art Blakey Live in 1965

programme.title: Alfa Jazz Festival Lviv, Oekraïne

programme.title: Franco Ambrosetti Quintet live at Estival Lugano

programme.title: Live in London 2013

programme.title: jazzahead! 2022 - Kathrine Windfeld Big Band

programme.title: Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet & Rozaa Wortham 1985
programme.desc: Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music. Jimmy Witherspoon, known for the song “Ain’t Nobody’s Business” ends the show with some astounding lean-back blues.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Boogieball with Anthony Hamilton
programme.desc: This episode of BIRD is a fantastic registration of the after party of the North Sea Jazz Festival. This mega jam session is a great coming together of, amongst others, Anthony Hamilton, Anderson Paak, Christian Scott, Cory Henry and Kneebody!

programme.title: R. Brecker, B. Wallace and Band - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: In 1987, American trumpeter Randy Brecker and saxophonist Bennie Wallace brought their band of pianist Elian Elias, drummer Peter Erskine and bassist Marc Johnson to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Together they put on a stellar duo performance.

programme.title: Teus Nobel live at the Bimhuis Amsterdam

programme.title: Troy 'Trombone Shorty' Andrews: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz phenomenon Trombone Shorty dishes out a mix of funk, jazz, hip-hop and soul at this concert at the French festival Jazz à Vienne. With his hypnotic performance and boundless energy, Trombone Shorty puts up an unparalleled performance.

programme.desc: Bootsy Collins' syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music strongly influenced funk music's development. Now in his 60s, Bootsy maintains that same energy, playing a spectacular show at Jazz à Vienne.

programme.title: Kenny Barron, Calypso
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity.

programme.title: Hamilton e Laginha - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: Grammy-nominated Hamilton de Holanda, who reintroduced the 10-string mandolin in Brazil, teams up with pianist Mário Laginha for stimulating duo performances of Brazil's musical treasures.

programme.title: Nasheet Waits - K-Kelli Sketch
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Marius Neset - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Copenhagen-based Norwegian saxophonist Marius Neset is known internationally for his collaborations with People Are Machines, Kaktusch, JazzKamikaze, and Django Bates' projects StoRMChaser and Human Chain.

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah, West Of The West
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah.

programme.desc: In this 2009 portrait of Marcus Miller, Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. He shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu', explaining how he wrote the title track.

programme.title: Brussels Jazz Orchestra & Bert Joris - Big Valses
programme.desc: Founded in 1993 by Frank Vaganée, Serge Plume and Marc Godfroid, the Brussels Jazz Orchestra is recognised and has been subsidised by the Flemish Government since. Brussels Jazz Orchestra is orchestra in residence at Flagey in Brussels.

programme.desc: In 1972, pianist Dave Brubeck and his trio of bassist Jack Six and drummer Alan Dawson appeared at the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam alongside prominent bassist Charles Mingus and his Sextet and Hammond organist Jimmy Smith and his band.

programme.title: A Quick Sketch
programme.desc: In 1982, the Superstar Quintet, which consists of trumpeter Freddie Hubbard, saxophonist Joe Henderson, drummer Tony Williams, bassist Ron Carter, and pianist Kenny Baron gave a performance of cosmic proportions at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Quartabe - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The unique Brazilian quartet Quartabê has influences ranging as widely as the São Paulo avant-garde movement, free improvisation, pop, and electronic music – and each of these influences gets its due share in the band's exhilarating performances!

programme.title: The Crusaders: Estival Lugano 1987
programme.desc: The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s. Their performance at Estival is beyond soulful and an amazing show to watch.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye

programme.title: Michael Bolton - Live at the Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: Join Michael Bolton for an unforgettable concert at London's famous Royal Albert Hall as he delivers hit after hit in his trademark soulful style in front of a packed audience. With his inimitable voice, charismatic stage presence and superb songwriting Michael Bolton holds the audience in the palm of his hand as he performs classics such as "How Am I Supposed To Live Without You?", "Time, Love And Tenderness", "Can I Touch You There" and "How Can We Be Lovers" alongside his unique interpretations of "Fly Me To The Moon", "Summertime", "That's Life" and "(Sittin' On) The Dock Of The Bay" plus his own rendition of "Murder My Heart", the hit he co-wrote with Lady Gaga. programme.title: Deep Purple - Live in Verona
programme.desc: Filmed in the spectacular surroundings of the Arena di Verona, a Roman amphitheater originally built in 30 AD, this concert from the summer of 2011 sees Deep Purple joined on stage by a full symphony orchestra for performances of all their classic tracks. Deep Purple remains one of the finest hard rock bands on the planet and are undoubtedly at their best when performing live. programme.title: John Mellencamp - Plain Spoken: Live in Chicago
programme.desc: John Mellencamp’s career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation. Filmed at the landmark Chicago Theatre, just 250 miles away from his upbringing in Indiana, this cinematic concert documentary film captures John Mellencamp reflecting on his career accompanied by self-narration from his highly personal audio diary on his Midwestern upbringing, career and outlook on life as a whole. Meant to be more than just your run of the mill concert film, this intimate performance with full band will fully envelop the viewer into the Mellencamp mindset. “My vision was true, and my heart was too. And there was no end to what I could dream. Life is short, even in its longest days.”

programme.title: Jerry Lee Lewis - Jerry Lee Lewis and Friends
programme.desc: Jerry Lee Lewis is one of the founding fathers of Rock n Roll. He was one of the original Sun Records quartet along with Elvis Presley, Carl Perkins and Johnny Cash who between them defined the music of a generation. His recording career has stretched from the mid-50s to the present day and his unique style of piano playing has influenced scores of musicians over the years. This concert, recorded at London's Hammersmith Apollo in 1989, features the killer in performances of his classic tracks such as Whole Lotta Shakin Goin On, What Id Say, High School Confidential and Great Balls Of Fire all delivered in his own inimitable fashion. Joining him on stage are a great list of guests including Van Morrison, Dave Edmunds, John Lodge, Brian May, Stuart Adamson and Dave Davies.

programme.title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Live from MSG
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out three-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in late February 2008 when icons Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their all-too-brief days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969. Whether they will ever team again is unknown. But with Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood Live From Madison Square Garden fans everywhere are able to experience the sound and the glory of a performance on that famous stage by two of rock's greatest artists.

programme.title: Harry Nilsson - Who is Harry Nilsson?
programme.desc: In this definitive documentary on the Grammy® award winning music legend Harry Nilsson, friends, family and colleagues delve into the acclaimed singer-songwriter's music, creative process and personal demons.

programme.title: John Legend - Live in London
programme.desc: An artist with intellectual skills is John Legend, who studied English with a major in African American literature at the University of Pennsylvania. In college, he participated in a jazz group called Counterparts and at the time was introduced to singer Lauryn Hill, playing piano on the track 'Everything Is Everything' from the singer's first solo album. He finished college in 1999 and began composing his own songs; Recorded two independent albums that were sold in their performances: 'John Stephens' (2000) and 'Live at Jimmy Uptown' (2001). He has performed on albums of singers like Alicia Key, Jay-Z and also made the album Wake Up! (2010) along with the American rap group, The Roots. His official discography includes Get Lifted (2004), Once Again (2006), Evolver (2008) and Love in the Future (2013). This presentation in London, 2014, at the Itunes Festival, manages to clean the career of this singer who besides being multitalented can be a human rights activist.

programme.title: George Michael - Live in London
programme.desc: George Michael winds down his 25 Live tour in his first-ever concert film, which finds the former Wham! leading man revisiting hits familiar and fresh in two sold-out shows at London's Earls Court. Michael's impeccable vocals take center stage, and his pop-song prowess is driven home with such classics as "Faith", "Freedom" and "One More Try". Even "Careless Whisper" gets a nod, as does the Police's "Roxanne".

programme.title: 90 de zile până la nuntă: Începutul poveştii
programme.desc: Ce se întâmplă înainte de cele 90 de zile, când cuplurile care aveau deja o relaţie online ajung să se cunoască pentru prima dată în persoană? Această serie fascinantă intră în culisele poveştilor, urmărind fiecare pereche de la început şi călătorind până în ţara de unde vine partenerul non-american. Ca să aplice pentru viza K-1, guvernul SUA le recomandă solicitanţilor o relaţie de cel puţin cinci săptămâni, ca să poată demonstra că sunt un cuplu adevărat. Dar nu cumva aura poveştii de dragoste trăite online se va spulbera în contact cu realităţile vieţii de zi cu zi?

programme.title: Dans murdar
programme.desc: Baby (Jennifer Grey) e o adolescenta de 17 ani, care in fiecare an isi petrece vacanta intr-o tabara de vara la Catskills. Vacanta pare a fi una obisnuita, pana cand atentia lui Baby este atrasa de instructorul de dans Johnny Castle (Patrick Swayze).

programme.title: Permis de căsătorie
programme.desc: Sadie a visat dintodeuna sa se marite in stil traditional. Problema e ca biserica St. Augustine n-are decat o zi libera in urmatorii doi ani in care nunta ar putea avea loc.

programme.title: Profesorul Marston și femeile fantastice
programme.sub-title: Professor Marston and the Wonder Women
programme.desc: Acest film biografic prezintă povestea doctorului William Marston, creatorul Femeii Fantastice și psiholog la Harvard, și modul în care supereroina a fost inspirată de relația poligamă dintre doctor, soția lui și o studentă care a devenit iubita lor.

programme.title: Ultima redută
programme.desc: Last Stand spune povestea lui Ray Owens (Arnold Schwarzenegger), un şerif dintr-un oraş american de la graniţa cu Mexicul, hotărât să ţină piept cu orice preţ traficanţilor de droguri care-şi fac de cap în jurisdicţia sa

programme.title: Domnul și doamna Smith
programme.desc: John si Jane Smith sunt casatoriti de 6 ani. Ceea ce nici unul nu stie despre celalalt este ca amandoi sunt asasini profesionisti, care cutreiera lumea in secret si ucid la comanda. Curând fiecare va primi misiunea sa-l scoata din joc pe celălalt.

programme.desc: Alimentație alternativă cu rețete sănătoase, sfaturi de organizare și trucuri ecologice de la nutriționistul Geneviève O'Gleman și echipa sa.

programme.title: La P'tite Librairie
programme.desc: François Busnel onorează lucrările emblematice ale literaturii franceze. Prin privirea sa expertă și pasionată, invită publicul să descopere sau să redescopere autori care au marcat epoca lor și ale căror scrieri continuă să rezoneze. Prezentare: Francois Busnel

programme.title: Château !
programme.desc: Meillant Castelul Meillant, un edificiu major al goticului flamboyant cu faimoasa sa turn Lion, are peste o mie de ani de istorie. Are particularitatea de a nu fi fost niciodată vândut. Prezentator: André Manoukian

programme.title: Ça Va L'faire !
programme.desc: Cele mai bune momente din programul matinal al postului TVMonaco.

programme.title: Le Téléjournal De Radio-Canada
programme.desc: Jurnalul televizat propus de redacţia Radio-Canada.

programme.title: Histoires Et Leçons
programme.desc: Fiecare episod spune un basm dintr-o țară diferită. Poveștile călătoresc prin timp și spațiu și transmit valori umane universale.

programme.title: My Class
programme.desc: Ortografie, gramatică, conjugare: aceste noțiuni esențiale ale limbii franceze sunt abordate de profesori în mod ludic, pentru a ajuta copiii, din clasa a patra până într-a șasea.

programme.title: Les Nouvelles Aventures De Kaeloo
programme.desc: În Pays-Trop-Mignon, Kaeloo, Moignon, Coin-Coin și Monsieur Chat joacă un joc nou în fiecare zi. Le place să inventeze o mulțime de reguli noi și să își pună întrebări despre lumea din jurul lor: cu ei, nimic nu este niciodată garantat! Realizator: Rémi Chapotot (sezonul 5, Franța, 2022)

programme.title: Dessine Les Animaux Avec Koumi
programme.desc: Koumi, 6 ani, veselă și poznașă, visează să cunoască toate animalele din lume. În plus, îi place să deseneze. În fiecare episod, ea explică cum se desenează corect animalele. Realizatori: Emmanuelle Reyss, Mathilde Menet (sezonul 2, Franța, 2023)

programme.title: Ta Vie Sans Ça
programme.desc: Care ar fi viața noastră fără obiecte de zi cu zi? În fiecare episod, unul dintre ele este evidențiat. Fie că este vorba de valiză, cronometru sau furculiță, toate au o poveste de spus despre crearea și evoluția lor. Prezentare generală: Sébastien Cimpayé, Sandrine Fagnant, Emy Lalune, Yan Imbault Regizat de: Sacha Laliberté (sezonul 2, Canada, 2025)

programme.title: Jad Et Ses Soeurs
programme.desc: Ranya și Syrine, surori gemene, sunt la fel de adorabile pe cât sunt de nedespărțite. Viața lor este plină de bucurie și de mici aventuri cotidiene. Dar totul va fi dat peste cap odată cu sosirea fratelui lor mai mic, Jad.

programme.title: Comme Des Têtes Pas De Poule
programme.desc: În neant Întoarsă de la New York, Vic vrea să-și încerce norocul ca profesoară de dans. Sigis trebuie să scrie un omagiu bunicului său decedat, dar are probleme cu găsirea cuvintelor. Regia: Pierre Théorêt, Yann Tanguay, Eza Peventi (sezonul 3, Canada, 2025) Scenariul: Pierre-Yves Bernard, Martin Doyon, Frédéric Lafleur, Jessica Veillet-Loblaw, Anne-Hélène Prévost Distribuția: Mélanie Pilon (Évelyne), David Savard (Ian), Estelle Fournier (Vic), Tristan Clouâtre (Félix), Élia St-Pierre (Flavie), Samara Healey (Marie), Devi Julia Pelletier (Cindy), Matai Stevens (Manolo), Adam Moussamih (Lounis), Emma Bao Linh Tourné (Zoé)

programme.title: Drôlement Débrouillards
programme.desc: Vikie Pedneault, biolog și umorist, adoră să realizeze experimente științifice… Doar dacă sunt amuzante! Mersul pe apă, alunecarea fără zăpadă sau dispariția unei banane: o modalitate de a învăța distrându-te. Prezentare: Vikie Pedneault

programme.title: Roi Keïta
programme.desc: Condé își pregătește răzbunarea. Regele Keïta este amenințat. Mai mult ca niciodată, va trebui să lupte pentru a-și apăra tronul, precum și membrii familiei sale. Regia: Abel Kouamé (sezonul 3, Coasta de Fildeș, 2023)

programme.title: Hiveraganza
programme.desc: Polyvalente des Monts versus Villa Maria College Elevii de la Polyvalente des Monts din Sainte-Agathe-des-Monts și de la Villa Maria College din Montreal se întrec în jocurile „Baraj” și „Discoteca polară”. Prezentator: Émilie Fournier

programme.title: La grande librairie
programme.desc: Actualitatea literală în care singurul cuvânt de ordine este plăcerea. Din meniu: scriitori cunoscuţi, de toate naţionalităţile, care ne inspiră să degustăm naraţiunea, să devorăm paginile, să savurăm cuvintele în calitate de gurmanzi rafinaţi ai literaturii.

programme.title: Vivement dimanche
programme.desc: Pe celebra canapea roşie a emisiunii "Vivement Dimanche", Michel Drucker ne reaminteşte evoluţia unor personalităţi din toate domeniile.

programme.title: Le journal de la rtbf
programme.desc: Ştiri detaliate din actualitatea internaţională propuse şi prezentate de redacţia RTBF.

programme.title: L'école Des Xv
programme.desc: Partea 1/2 În nordul Franței, țara fotbalului, o școală face un pariu îndrăzneț: să folosească rugbyul pentru a readuce pe drumul cel bun elevii de gimnaziu aflați în dificultate. Imersiune în noua filială din Lille a École des XV, o structură hibridă care combină sprijinul școlar, ajutorul la teme și practicarea rugbyului... Regia: Olivier Gresse (Franța, 2026)

programme.title: Château !
programme.desc: Chémery - La Rivière Castelul Chémery este un amestec de arhitectură medievală și renascentistă. A aparținut cândva cântărețului Alain Souchon și este în prezent în curs de restaurare. Château de La Rivière făcea parte din proiectul nebunesc și neterminat de a aduce apă din Eure la Versailles pentru a alimenta fântânile Regelui Soare. Prezentator: André Manoukian.

programme.title: Questions pour un champion
programme.desc: Joc de cultură generală prezentat de Julien Lepers.

programme.title: Franc-Jeu
programme.desc: În perioada premergătoare campaniei prezidențiale franceze, "Franc-jeu" salută principalii lideri politici și oferă un loc central dezbaterilor majore care marchează viața publică. Benjamin Duhamel îi întreabă pe cei care participă la alegerile oferite francezilor pentru viitorul țării: un dialog direct, exigent și accesibil, fără pretenții sau concesii.

programme.title: Le dessous des cartes
programme.desc: Emisiune pe teme de geopolitică şi cartografie de Jean-Christophe Victor, concepută şi elaborată de LÉPAC (Laboratorul de studii politice şi analiză cartografică), în colaborare cu realizatori şi graficieni.

programme.desc: Știrile zilnice importante ale TV5MONDE care descifrează evenimentele actuale! Economie, dezbateri sociale, știri internaționale: domeniile de specialitate ale jurnaliștilor redacției. Noi cronici în weekend: lumea francofonă, rețelele sociale, știri false, politică, sport...

programme.title: Des racines & des ailes
programme.desc: Urcând pe râul Lot. Descoperiți istoria acestui curs de apă văzut din aer, de la bordul unui aparat de zbor ultra-ușor. Din Evul Mediu până la începutul secolului trecut, râul Lot era folosit pentru transportul mărfurilor din Masivul central până la portul din Bordeaux. În secolul al XIX-lea, acesta cunoaște o perioadă de mare înflorire industrială, fosfatul fiind secretul bogăției acestei regiuni.

programme.title: De Terry Fox À Aujourd'hui
programme.desc: Episodul 1 28 iunie 1981. Terry Fox, în vârstă de 22 de ani, moare din cauza unui sarcom agresiv. Cu câteva săptămâni mai devreme, cu un picior amputat, atletul se angajase în Maratonul Speranței pentru a strânge fonduri pentru lupta împotriva sarcomului. Călătoria sa prin Canada s-a întrerupt brusc. Realizator: Jean-François Fontaine (Canada, 2022)

programme.title: Le 23h
programme.desc: Jurnalul de știri de la ora 23:00 al franceinfo (ora Parisului). Regăsiți reportaje, interviuri și analizele redacției a celor mai recente evenimente din Franța și din lume.

programme.title: Un Soare atât de mare
programme.desc: Crimă, pasiune și secrete de familie sub soarele din Montpellier.

programme.title: Escapades En Suisse Italienne
programme.desc: Cufundați-vă în inima Ticino pentru a descoperi locuri fermecătoare, explorați trasee de excursii noi, bucurați-vă de diverse activități sportive și de agrement și savurați produse locale de excepție. O călătorie senzorială prin experiențe unice și autentice!

programme.title: 6h Info
programme.desc: Jurnalul de știri de la ora 6:00 (ora Parisului) realizat de redacția France Télévisions.

programme.title: Météo
programme.desc: Buletinul meteo internaţional.

programme.title: Oum Le Dauphin Blanc
programme.desc: Într-un un atol din Polynezia, Yann și surioara lui Marina locuiesc împreună cu unchiul lor Patrick, oceanograf renumit. Cei doi copii se întâlnesc cu Oum, un delfin alb misterios, gata oricând să vină în ajutorul celor care îl iubesc. Prietenia lor îi va împinge să exploreze bogățiile adâncurilor mării.

programme.title: Billy Le Hamster Cowboy
programme.desc: Billy a crescut în Vestul Sălbatic. Are deja costumul său de cowboy și, mai presus de toate, gustul pentru aventură! Împreună cu prietenii săi inseparabili, viermele de pământ Jean-Claude și dihorul Suzie, este gata să înfrunte situații la fel de spinoase ca cactușii. Realizator: Antoine Rota, Caz Murell (Franța, 2022) Bazat pe cărțile scrise de Catharina Valckx. Premii: Premiul pentru serial de animație pentru 4-6 ani la Festivalul de la Luchon (Franța, 2022)

programme.title: Billy Le Hamster Cowboy
programme.desc: Billy a crescut în Vestul Sălbatic. Are deja costumul său de cowboy și, mai presus de toate, gustul pentru aventură! programme.title: Róbert Bede: Regiuni, arome, tradiţii
programme.desc: Maestrul bucătar Róbert Bede ne prezintă, de data aceasta, legăturile dintre gastronomia maghiară și cultură printr-o călătorie în întreaga țară. În fiecare episod, împreună cu gazda sa într-un mediu unic și superb, prepară rețetele oferind telespectatorilor o privire asupra culturii și modului de viață în localitatea respectivă.

programme.title: La drum cu Gordon, Gino şi Fred
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino și Fred își pregătesc bagajele, urcă în rulotă și pornesc în Europa. Fiecare episod îi călăuzește pe telespectatori prin țara natală a unuia dintre ei, unde vor pregăti un ospăț special. Aventurile extraordinare sunt marcate și de opriri nedorite, cauzate nu numai de rulotă, în timp ce ei se întrec în găsirea celor mai bune ingrediente în locurile cele mai spectaculoase. Serialul începe în Italia, unde Gordon și Fred își unesc forțele ca să-l ajute pe Gino să pregătească un festin cu ocazia unei nunți deosebite pe malul mării. În Franța, cei trei asistă la organizarea primului festival al stridiilor, iar în episodul din Scoția al călătoriei vor degusta glumele și jocurile caracteristice regiunii Highlands.

programme.title: Aventuri culinare în Franţa cu James Martin
programme.desc: În noul său serial dedicat călătoriilor şi gătitului, James Martin, bucătarul cunoscut de pe micile ecrane, se îndreaptă către Franţa unde vizitează locuri cu un impact major asupra carierei sale culinare, aducând totodată un omagiu memoriei lui Keith Floyd, modelul său în domeniul profesional. În adolescenţă, James vizitase Franţa ca turist şi ca student, pasiunea sa pentru mâncăruri datorându-se în parte acestui fapt. Serialul surprinde călătoria nostalgică a lui James pe parcursul căreia acesta parcurge popasurile memorabile străbătute de eroul său, Keith Floyd, în urmă cu 30 de ani, vizitând în acelaşi timp şi locurile devenite pietre de temelie în propria sa carieră culinară. Descoperirea şi gustarea celor mai delicioase bucate franţuzeşti începe în Provenţa şi continuă în Périgord, Burgundia, Alsacia, Ţara Bascilor şi Bretagne. În călătoria sa, James găteşte şi propria versiune a celebrelor mâncăruri, folosind ingrediente găsite la faţa locului. Pentru a-şi manifesta respectul faţă de bucătarul Keith Floyd, James îşi urmează itinerarul la volanul unui Citroën 2CV aflat timp de 16 ani în proprietatea eroului său. Pe parcursul aventurilor sale din Franţa, James Martin redescoperă regiunile cele mai îndrăgite de el şi bătrânul său prieten şi mâncărurile magnifice ale acestora.

programme.title: James Martin: Mâncăruri de suflet
programme.desc: James Martin ne invită în propria bucătărie ca să ne împărtăşească reţetele cu gusturi de acasă, precum şi secretele şi practicile care merită ştiute de orice gospodină. Bucatele de acasă nu sunt renumite tocmai pentru aspectul elegant şi nici nu sunt foarte plăcute ochiului, dar dacă lingura de lemn e în mâna lui James, putem fi siguri că mâncarea va fi cel puţin gustoasă.

programme.title: Prăjiturile unite ale Americii cu James Martin
programme.desc: Celebrul bucătar James Martin călătorește pe coasta de est a SUA într-un automobil clasic și învață secretele gătitului de la cofetari amatori și profesioniști înainte de a-și prezenta propria abordare a rețetelor americane. Mai mult, Martin desființează miturile rețetelor clasice ca negresele și plăcinta cu mere și descoperă dulciuri mai puțin cunoscute printre care pumpple cake (o combinație de prăjitură și plăcintă cu mere și dovleac) și shoofly pie (plăcinta cu melasă).

programme.title: Marcus Wareing La Marea Mediterană: Mallorca
programme.desc: Marcus prepară supă rece de roșii și salată de pepene verde, ambele perfecte pentru un prânz la soare. El îl vizitează pe Marc Fosh, care îi gătește o minunată doradă prăjită în tigaie. După ce a găsit prânzul perfect pentru o zi însorită, Marcus prepară o înghețată inspirată din Mallorca.

programme.title: Silvia: Bucătăria italiană
programme.desc: Puţine lucruri sunt mai liniştitoare decât un bol de paste calde. În acest episod, Silvia ne prezintă reţetele ei preferate cu paste, direct din carneţelul bunicii, preparate care amintesc de o îmbrăţişare.

programme.title: Pur şi simplu Raymond
programme.desc: De data aceasta, Raymond Blanc dezvăluie secretele mâncărurilor sale preferate într-un serial cu accente personale și noutăți și ne arată rețete nou-nouțe care i-au atras atenția ca expert. Putem observa pasiunea lui pentru produsele proaspete în timp ce vizitează grădinile sale imense și îi invită pe cei mai celebri bucătari ai țării să-și împărtășească rețetele cu spectatorii.

programme.title: Un barbecue suprem cu Jamie
programme.desc: Jamie se apucă de minunățiile sale afumate cu lemne: gătește mușchiul de vită în trei feluri, ne arată cum putem prăji pe grătar un pui și un pește întreg fără stres și prepară acadele delicioase de miel.

programme.title: Jamie Găteşte În Georgia
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver pleacă într-o aventură culinară prin Georgia, explorând pieţele aglomerate din Tbilisi şi frumoasa regiune viticolă Kakheti. Se întâlneşte cu bucătari locali, savurează bucate tradiţionale şi participă la un festival Supra. Inspirat fiind de gastronomia georgiană, aflată la intersecţia Orientului cu Occidentul, Jamie pregăteşte o cină cu aer georgian, folosind pui la rotisor cu ierburi aromate şi salsa verde cu nuci.

programme.title: River Cottage în Australia
programme.desc: Hugh Fearnley-Whittingstall, celebrul bucătar englez, personalitate din televiziune, autor culinar și susținător al cauzelor gastronomice și de mediu, și-a început experimentul cu mulți ani în urmă, sub egida durabilității și autosuficienței. S-a mutat pe o fermă din Dorset, s-a apucat de agricultură și creșterea animalelor, integrându-se în comunitatea locală nu doar pentru a-și împărtăși cunoștințele, ci și roadele gospodăriei autosuficiente. Hugh aduce acum acest experiment și mesajul durabilității și pe continentul sudic. Predă ștafeta colegului australian, bucătarul din Tasmania, Paul West, care trebuie să se confrunte cu noi provocări în timp ce încearcă să-și creeze propria gospodărie în apropierea pitorescului sat istoric, Central Tilba, pe malurile sudice ale statului New South Wales.

programme.title: Marea confruntare a ciocolatei
programme.desc: În această finală epică a sezonului, cofetarii amatori se confruntă cu cea mai solicitantă probă din întreaga competiție - crearea unei vitrine dulci, delicioase și senzaționale. Un cofetar va câștiga marele premiu de 50.000 de dolari și titlul de campion al emisiunii Marea confruntare a ciocolatei.

programme.title: Reţete clasice de familie
programme.desc: În acest nou serial cu şase episoade, Jamie Oliver găteşte pentru noi felurile de mâncare preferate ale familiei, combinând, într-o manieră simplă, tot de felul de bunătăţi cu un conţinut nutritiv echilibrat care asigură telespectatorilor o viaţă mai sănătoasă şi mai fericită.

programme.title: Prue Leith: Bucătăria mea din Cotswold
programme.desc: Prue găteşte mai multe preparate ideale pentru musafiri, înainte să i se alăture Alison Hammond pentru a pregăti un desert. Încercând să arate cât este de polivalent pepenele, Prue face două preparate cu el. Pentru a face preparate simple şi delicioase pentru petreceri, Prue foloseşte un ingredient cumpărat. John, soţul lui Prue, merge la o fermă ca să vadă cum sunt dresaţi câinii care păzesc oile. Şi prietenii lor ne spun cum afumă somonul folosind metode clasice.

programme.title: Mary Berry - Bucate clasice
programme.desc: Serialul ne dă posibilitatea să aflăm de ce este Mary Berry un chef genial, un mentor și de ce este atât de stimulantă asupra unora. Rolul principal din unele episoade este preluat de diferite mâncăruri, în fiecare episod veți avea parte de un meniu cu un stil diferit: pe unele le cunoaștem bine, altele vor fi total necunoscute față de meniurile noastre obișnuite. Dar trăsătura comună dintre acestea este modul caracteristic de preparare al chef Mary: tehnici ușor de însușit, doar câteva ingrediente și deja obișnuitele idei simplificatoare ale bucătăresei, care pot fi aplicate cu ușurință de oricine.

programme.title: Mary Berry - Bucate clasice
programme.desc: Serialul ne dă posibilitatea să aflăm de ce este Mary Berry un chef genial, un mentor și de ce este atât de stimulantă asupra unora. Rolul principal din unele episoade este preluat de diferite mâncăruri, în fiecare episod veți avea parte de un meniu cu un stil diferit: pe unele le cunoaștem bine, altele vor fi total necunoscute față de meniurile noastre obișnuite. programme.title: Aventurile lui James Martin în Marea Britanie
programme.desc: "Inspirat de aventurile sale în Franța, maestrul bucătar James Martin își continuă circuitul gastronomic, următoarea stație a acestuia fiind Statele Unite ale Americii. În timp ce trece în revistă cele mai captivante, surprinzătoare, diverse și minunate bucate care întrec orice imaginație, James încearcă să pătrundă în adâncul spiritului țării. În acest serial, James evocă paleta surprinzătoare și seducătoare a culturii culinare americane, în timp ce prepară versiunile proprii ale mâncărurilor clasice – mai întâi pe drum, apoi acasă, în bucătăria sa din Anglia."

programme.title: David Rocco: Mâncând pe bune
programme.desc: De data aceasta, David se află în Palermo pentru a explora una dintre cele mai zgomotoase şi mai sălbatice pieţe stradale din Europa, iar apoi se delectează cu cele mai proaspete fructe de mare disponibile în Siracusa, Sicilia, înainte de a se relaxa şi a se bucura de cultura aperitivelor în inima Florenţei.

programme.title: Gino: Secretele Sudului Italiei
programme.desc: Revenind la comorile ascunse ale patriei sale, Gino pornește într-o călătorie culinară în timp ce le prezintă telespectatorilor regiunile mai puțin cunoscute din cea mai sudică parte a Italiei: Puglia și Basilicata. El dezvăluie cea mai uimitoare față a țării: aventurându-se în colțul sudic și talpa „cizmei” italiene, călătorește prin spații romantice intercalate cu munți stâncoși, orașe peșteră antice, plaje cu nisip și ape limpezi de un albastru strălucitor. Aceste regiuni păstrează însă multe secrete: o mare parte a istoriei lor este împletită cu popoarele antice grecești și bizantine care au ocupat zona, a căror influență se observă în plantele cultivate local, în gastronomia locală și chiar în dialectul vorbit în această regiune, devenită un creuzet al popoarelor.

programme.title: Raymond Blanc: Turul grădinilor regale
programme.desc: De data aceasta, Raymond Blanc dezvăluie secretele mâncărurilor sale preferate într-un serial cu accente personale și noutăți și ne arată rețete nou-nouțe care i-au atras atenția ca expert. Putem observa pasiunea lui pentru produsele proaspete în timp ce vizitează grădinile sale imense și îi invită pe cei mai celebri bucătari ai țării să-și împărtășească rețetele cu spectatorii.

programme.title: Reţete clasice de familie
programme.desc: În acest nou serial cu şase episoade, Jamie Oliver găteşte pentru noi felurile de mâncare preferate ale familiei, combinând, într-o manieră simplă, tot de felul de bunătăţi cu un conţinut nutritiv echilibrat care asigură telespectatorilor o viaţă mai sănătoasă şi mai fericită.

programme.title: Prue Leith: Bucătăria mea din Cotswold
programme.desc: Prue găteşte mai multe preparate ideale pentru musafiri, înainte să i se alăture Alison Hammond pentru a pregăti un desert. Încercând să arate cât este de polivalent pepenele, Prue face două preparate cu el. Pentru a face preparate simple şi delicioase pentru petreceri, Prue foloseşte un ingredient cumpărat. John, soţul lui Prue, merge la o fermă ca să vadă cum sunt dresaţi câinii care păzesc oile. Şi prietenii lor ne spun cum afumă somonul folosind metode clasice.

programme.title: Mary Berry - Bucate clasice
programme.desc: Serialul ne dă posibilitatea să aflăm de ce este Mary Berry un chef genial, un mentor și de ce este atât de stimulantă asupra unora. Rolul principal din unele episoade este preluat de diferite mâncăruri, în fiecare episod veți avea parte de un meniu cu un stil diferit: pe unele le cunoaștem bine, altele vor fi total necunoscute față de meniurile noastre obișnuite. Dar trăsătura comună dintre acestea este modul caracteristic de preparare al chef Mary: tehnici ușor de însușit, doar câteva ingrediente și deja obișnuitele idei simplificatoare ale bucătăresei, care pot fi aplicate cu ușurință de oricine.

programme.title: Mary Berry - Bucate clasice
programme.desc: Serialul ne dă posibilitatea să aflăm de ce este Mary Berry un chef genial, un mentor și de ce este atât de stimulantă asupra unora.
